title: grip.security Request/Response
description: Schemas for the grip.security primitive — loads security rules filtered by resource type and compliance framework.

SecurityRequest.description: Request to load security rules for a resource type.

resourceType.description: Cloud resource type to load rules for.

frameworks.description: Compliance frameworks to filter by. Empty or omitted means all available rules.

resourceType.description: The resource type rules were loaded for.

frameworks.description: The compliance frameworks that were applied as filters.

rules.description: Rule content in provider-native format. The format is implementation-specific (e.g., CFN Guard DSL for AWS, OPA/Rego for other providers).
